en: Black‑and‑white street scene of a European town with cobblestone pavement and 3–4 story townhouses lining both sides. On the left stands a large, somewhat worn building with small windows and a roof turret with a bell or small cupola. On the right are ornate late‑19th‑century façades with shopfronts at street level. Several pedestrians, including children and women in long skirts, walk along the street. Shop signs in German are visible, including a bakery and a delicatessen.
